text:
anya: Quick sync — drafting the benchmark narrative for next week's launch. We need a concise two-chart story (latency vs unit-cost) + a short decision callout (when to pick Dedicated vs Hosted). Thoughts on axes, audience slices, and inbound routing hooks?

matt: Audience? SMB devs or platform teams? or both? That changes framing.

liz: We can do both but separate slices. We have microbench v2.1 for seq=256/1024 and embeddings. Suggest 3 slices: Chat (256), Document (1024), Embeddings. Use p50 & p95 latency and tokens-per-second -> unit $ extrapolated.

sam: Visuals: small-multiples with shared y-axis for latency, second chart below for $/1k tokens. Color by model family, annotate where Dedicated capacity crosses cost parity. Add a tiny decision box: "Prefer Dedicated when sustained QPS > X".

sam: quick axes sketch:
```
x-axis: workload slice (chat/doc/emb)
y-axis: latency (ms) - log scale
secondary y-axis: $ per 1k tokens
``` 

marco: Important: don't say "cheaper and faster" flatly. Show tradeoffs. Copy should be: "Lower unit cost at scale; predictable latency with Dedicated" :thinking: 

liz: Hook copy options:
- "Ship features faster — control latency and cost as you scale"
- "Choose the right runtime for predictable costs"

liz: Inbound routing: CTA -> landing page with cost calculator + webinar sign-up. Email follow-up segmented by org size.

anya: Plan: sam mock visuals today, liz drafts landing + 2x copy hooks, matt to pull p50/p95 numbers and costs by tomorrow EOD. Quick sync 9am PT tomorrow. @sam @liz @matt :thumbsup: 

aria-bot: Viz mock deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood/viz/1715209999 :rocket: 

matt: I'll surface the segment numbers in the doc and flag any outliers. thanks everyone.

anya: great — thanks. We'll iterate after the mock. :raised_hands:
